self.title: Cycle 43 · Predictive Information and Dissipation Bounds

detail.title: Predictive Information and Dissipation Bounds
detail.summary: This research iteration integrates constraints imposed by coarse-graining and trajectory-based inference on entropy production, formalizing the bounds for nonequilibrium systems. The findings synthesize recent literature regarding the informational cost of nonequilibrium operations and the limits of thermodynamic retrieval.
